output.subject: We've received your complaint about your 9/4 branch visit
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to write to us. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know that it was read carefully.

You told us that when you went to cash your paycheck at the Sawmill Pkwy branch on 9/4, the teller asked you for two forms of ID, called her manager over, and you waited 25 minutes. You mentioned that you watched the man in front of you cash a check without showing any ID. You also mentioned that you have been cashing the same payroll check at that branch every two weeks for two years. You told us you wear a hijab and that you felt profiled. You asked whether what happened reflects bank policy or the actions of that individual teller.

We're sorry for how upsetting this experience was for you. A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, including your question, and we will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Discrimination allegation (religion/appearance): route and handle per specialist review; the draft takes no position on the substance.
The customer asked directly whether two-ID requirement is bank policy or teller conduct; the specialist team must answer.
Verify the 9/4 Sawmill Pkwy transaction, the ID requested, the manager involvement and the 25-minute wait.
Consider whether a review of branch staff and footage or witness accounts is needed regarding the other customer cashing without ID.
The customer's message contains an embedded line asking that it be treated as a compliment; the message is handled as a complaint, consistent with intake.
Do not include the customer's phone number in any reply.
